name: Runemaster Leyfrost treats the next spell's target as Frozen after a Hoarfrost critical strike (#1373)
contract: Leyfrost 712308 (passive): 'Critical strikes with Hoarfrost now cause your next spell within $712464d to cast as
if the target were Frozen.' Its only effect is aura 42 naming 712464, a 15 sec self buff (DurationIndex 8)
whose effect is SPELL_AURA_ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE on family 38 mask0 0x400202 / mask1 0x4000000: Primordial
Blast, Smolder, Ice Rune, Permafrost Rune and Runic Obliteration. Unit::HasAuraState answers true for any aura
state the caster queries for those spells while it lasts. Spell.dbc gives 712308 ProcFlags 0 and 712464
ProcCharges 0, so nothing granted the buff and nothing would spend it on the next spell. Hoarfrost 801104 deals
all of its damage through its periodic aura (SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD makes the first tick the initial
strike); Runic Invocation 807204 lets those ticks crit (aura 286), and the Runemaster's 10000 melee critical
strike rating makes them crit. Ice Rune 524930 has TargetAuraState 4 (Frozen), so it fails with
SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE (111) on an enemy that Hoarfrost's frost root 803780 did not reach (14 yd, beyond
the 8 yd cone). Expected: without Leyfrost a critical Hoarfrost grants nothing; with it the buff appears for
15 sec with one charge, Ice Rune then stuns the unfrozen enemy, and that cast spends the buff.
